item.title: Opening Segment | ‘Hit the Slopes’ with Our Co-Hosts
item.description: The Winter Olympics in Milan-Cortina are officially in full swing, which prompted co-hosts Carrie Lujan and Dave Caldwell to "hit the slopes" and take a trip down memory lane.

item.title: Training Tuesdays with M – Crucial Physical Activity
item.description: In this episode of Training Tuesdays with M, host Emily Larbaoui from Santa Clarita shares statistics from the National Academy of Sports Medicine (NASM) Essentials of Personal Fitness Training by Dr. Mike Clark and offers a variety of ideas to help viewers stay healthy

item.title: SCV Water Customers Asked to Pause Outdoor Water Use until Feb. 24
item.description: Customers of the Santa Clarita Valley Water Agency customers are being asked, once again, to pause all outdoor water use from now until Feb. 24.

item.title: Feb. 21: “Off to the Races’ with Bridge to Home’s Meaningful Soup for the Soul Gala
item.description: Dust off your fascinators, Derby hats, seersucker suits, and bow ties and make a difference at Bridge to Home's Annual Soup for the Soul Gala, "Off to the Races."

item.title: Feb. 27: WiSH Education Foundation’s Annual Hart District’s Got Talent Variety Show
item.description: Join the WiSH Education Foundation as they showcase the annual Hart District Got Talent Variety Show Feb. 27, doors open at 6 p.m., at Saugus High School.

item.title: Daily School Broadcasts for February 18, 2026
item.description: Daily School Broadcasts for February 18, 2026, from Saugus High School, West Ranch High School, Valencia High School, Rio Norte Junior High School, and Sierra Vista Junior High School.

item.title: SCV 101: Patty Hackett & Peggy Honore, SCV Golden Girls
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda talks to Patty Hacket and Peggy Honore from the SCV Golden Girls, an organization that provides financial services to individuals looking to secure their future, protect loved ones, or prepare for retirement. They also talk about S.O.S., Serving Our Seniors, which is an organization that aims to make resources available to senior citizens of Santa Clarita such as transportation, medical assistance, financial planning, and more

item.title: March 14: Honor Cancer Survivors, Caregivers at American Cancer Society’s Celebration Dinner
item.description: Cancer survivors and caregivers are cordially invited to the American Cancer Society's Celebration Dinner March 14 at the Canyon Country Community Center.

item.title: Meet Rome a Handsome Pup from Sunny Day Acres Ready for His Forever Home
item.description: In this adorable segment of SCVTV's Community Corner, Jen Gray, founder of Sunny Day Acres, introduces us to Rome, a handsome Staffordshire Terrier, who's looking for his forever family.
